Chapters 1 to 10 are review sets on the same topics, with matching, sorting and multiple choice; many sentences are new. The other drills are rebuilt from the answer keys (Övningsbok and Textbok facit). The keys do not include the exercise instructions, so each drill has a short note of what it practises. Multiple-choice exercises (a, b, c, d) are left out because the question text is not in the keys. Where an answer looks wrong or you disagree, trust your book.
